commands.command: cd frontend && corepack pnpm@11.7.0 run typecheck
cd frontend && corepack pnpm@11.7.0 run test
commands.note: 18 pre-existing failures in 4 files, identical on the untouched master baseline b5926f288; the two new feature suites pass (24 tests)

cases.note: A profile with no intro post appears in discovery. tests/discovery.rs::a_profile_with_no_intro_post_is_discoverable asserts the subject has zero intro_posts rows and is still returned.
The discovery query text never references intro_posts or intro_id. tests/discovery.rs::the_discovery_query_never_references_intro_posts.

A profile with no overlap is not claimed as sharing. tests/discovery.rs::a_profile_with_no_overlap_is_not_claimed_as_sharing: absent from the people list, and shared_items is a present empty array, never omitted.

The response contains no numeric score field. tests/discovery.rs::the_response_contains_no_numeric_score_field walks the serialized page, rejects every numeric value and every score/rank/match/count-like key, and asserts the PeopleCard key set.
The discovery schema has no score column and no intro reference. tests/discovery.rs::the_discovery_schema_has_no_score_column, a_discovery_profile_has_no_intro_reference.
K-pop is absent from music search results. tests/catalog_search.rs::a_kpop_artist_is_absent_from_music_search (seed policy records, no stored row, no search hit).

K-pop exclusion is catalog policy, not string filtering. tests/catalog_search.rs::the_database_refuses_a_kpop_music_row asserts constraint catalog_items_music_excludes_kpop; a_music_row_requires_an_exclusion_review asserts catalog_items_music_requires_exclusion_review.
The same query returns the same order twice. tests/catalog_search.rs::the_same_query_returns_the_same_order_twice, including across a page boundary.
An unknown discovery query field is 400. tests/discovery_routes.rs::an_unknown_query_field_is_a_client_error.

A sixth favorite in one category is rejected. tests/catalog_search.rs and tests/discovery.rs::a_sixth_mirrored_favorite_is_refused assert the database constraint; FavoritePicker.test.tsx::blocks_a_sixth_pick_in_one_category asserts the UI and the contract.
Skipping all categories leaves the profile usable. FavoritePicker.test.tsx::skipping_every_category_leaves_the_profile_usable: empty selection is valid, canSave is true, no control is blocked.

The shared-interest line is omitted when there is no overlap. Discovery.test.tsx::omits_the_shared-interest_line_when_there_is_no_overlap (sharedInterestLine returns null, the decoder refuses a card that claims nothing).
Opening the room is not offered from a discovery card. Discovery.test.tsx::offers_no_room_preview_or_room_action_on_a_discovery_card.
The people list and the mutuals-intro list are never merged. Discovery.test.tsx::keeps_the_people_list_and_the_mutuals-intro_list_as_separate_tabs.

limitations: The gateway does not serve /api/catalog/{category}/search or /api/discover/people yet. The frozen operations exist and the producers exist; mounting the routes is the gateway work package's scope, so this evidence is at the producer and client level, not an end-to-end HTTP capture.

The discovery projection (discovery_profiles, discovery_favorite_items, discovery_blocks) is written by no producer yet. Favorites are owned by the profile service and discovery reads the concert service, so a projection writer is a separate work package. The query and schema are complete and tested against real rows.
core.PeopleCard.avatar is required by the frozen schema but the concert service has no avatar store; the card type omits it until the avatar projection exists. This is recorded as a deviation.
The catalog seed is a curated manifest of 39 stored rows plus 4 K-pop policy records. It is a seed, not a provider integration, and it is intentionally small.
The full frontend suite has 18 pre-existing failures in 4 unrelated files, reproduced identically on the untouched master baseline b5926f288.
